svg.title: VOID-on-removal — the Tyvek transfer-killer
svg.desc: The adhesive closure carries a calibrated void pattern: the wristband cannot be removed intact, and peeling exposes a repeating VOID print on the closure area. Tyvek 1073D / 1082D spunbond HDPE is the same material family as courier envelopes and protective coveralls.
svg.text: Take it off and it spells out what you did
Calibrated VOID adhesive — one band, one wrist, one day

g.text: Why Tyvek carries the day shift
DuPont Tyvek 1073D / 1082D spunbond HDPE — the same material family as courier envelopes and protective coveralls
Tear-resistant and water-tolerant for a full festival day, printable edge to edge in flexo or digital
Security finishes: holographic foil, UV-fluorescent ink, sequential numbering + QR alongside the chip
HF 13.56 MHz ISO/IEC 14443-A — NTAG213 / 215 / 216, MIFARE options for cashless builds
